passage.text: Top is twenty-one years old, and he studies business at a university in Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈtɑːp ɪz ˌtwɛnti ˈwʌn ˈjɪrz ˈoʊld, ənd hiː ˈstʌdiz ˈbɪznəs ət ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: He has lectures from nine until three.
passage.reading: hiː ˈhæz ˈlɛktʃərz frəm ˈnaɪn ənˈtɪl ˈθriː.

passage.text: In the evening, he works at a café near the university.
passage.reading: ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ, hiː ˈwɜːrks ət ə kæˈfeɪ ˈnɪr ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

passage.text: His shift is from five until ten, five days a week.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈʃɪft ɪz frəm ˈfaɪv ənˈtɪl ˈtɛn, ˈfaɪv ˈdeɪz ə ˈwiːk.

passage.text: His uniform is a black T-shirt with the café's name on it.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈjuːnəfɔːrm ɪz ə ˈblæk ˈtiːʃɜːrt wɪð ðə kæˈfeɪz ˈneɪm ɑːn ɪt.

passage.text: He makes coffee and serves customers, and his manager is very nice.
passage.reading: hiː ˈmeɪks ˈkɔːfi ənd ˈsɜːrvz ˈkʌstəmərz, ənd hɪz ˈmænɪdʒər ɪz ˈvɛri ˈnaɪs.

passage.text: Top is always busy, but he likes his job.
passage.reading: ˈtɑːp ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ˈbɪzi, bʌt hiː ˈlaɪks hɪz ˈdʒɑːb.

passage.text: He wants to save money for a trip to Japan next year.
passage.reading: hiː ˈwɑːnts tə ˈseɪv ˈmʌni fər ə ˈtrɪp tə dʒəˈpæn ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr.
